result: Ordinary SGD with a simple ball-restart rule and averaged output reaches an ε-second-order stationary point in Õ(ε^{−3.5}) stochastic gradients under dispersive noise, beating the classical ε^{−4} without added perturbations or variance reduction.
result_plain: Plain SGD escapes saddles in Õ(ε^−3.5) stochastic gradients (dispersive noise, anchor-ball rule).
